states.name: Helsing
states.title: Twilight Avenger
states.description: As a dreamy young girl, Helsing loved the meat pies her mother made. Whenever she would cry, her mother would bake one for her and make the tears stop. The two of them had always lived together in poverty, just mother and daughter. Even so, looking back, those were the happiest years of her life.

states.name: Helsing
states.title: Twilight Avenger
states.description:
Helsing admired the castle that stood atop the hill overlooking the town where she lived with her mother.
Each night, whenever the bells rang, she imagined herself taking the hand of a prince she had yet to meet, dancing with him in a splendid hall.

She never knew that every night within that mansion, a dance of death was being performed by monsters thirsting for blood.

states.name: Helsing
states.title: Twilight Avenger
states.description:
Her mother, Ekaterina, taught her young daughter the name of a certain flower. A flower with a sweet fragrance and delicate beauty, yet hiding a deadly poison within.

"Whether something becomes poison or medicine depends on the heart of the one who uses it."

Ten years later, the daughter would turn the lesson her mother had given her into a weapon of revenge, and quietly close in on the throat of the monster who had stolen her mother away.
